evidence.F1: endTurn() calls phases in fixed order; s.rng (mulberry32-style) used for map/colonists/hazard/events/trade
evidence.F2: adjMult from hasAdjacency() multiplies into eff in phaseProduction()
evidence.F3: workshop consumes def.input.metal to produce parts in phaseProduction(); overflow capped at storageCaps
evidence.F4: phaseProduction() reads col.skill and col.fatigue to build skillMult/fatigueMult
evidence.F5: phaseNeeds() shortage sets d-=10 on c.morale; moraleMult reads col.morale in phaseProduction()
evidence.F6: doResearch() calls node.effect(s) setting researchBonuses.*Yield, read as yieldMult in phaseProduction()
evidence.F7: phaseEvents() weighted pool draw; eventCooldown set/decremented; 5 events with differing 2-choice apply()
evidence.F8: buyPrice/sellPrice read resources ratio + globalDemand (drifts in phaseTrade); doTrade both branches work
evidence.F9: phaseHazard() damages buildings every 8 turns, severity scales with turn; damagedMult=0.5 in phaseProduction; repairBuilding costs 5 parts
evidence.F10: uiSave() JSON.stringify to textarea; uiLoad() parses + validateState() with specific error text
evidence.F11: checkWinLose() sets win/lose; computeScore() combines multiple state values; renderEndScreen() shown on gameOver
evidence.F12: uiSetTab()/render() tab switch; addLog stores turn; title= tooltips; keydown wires Space/1-5; narrow-screen media query
evidence.F13: runTests() asserts real invariants; simulateHeadless()+hashState() run 200 turns headless, print determinism hash
evidence.G1: researchBonuses.greenhouseYield (set by hydroponics effect) read as yieldMult in phaseProduction()
evidence.G2: phaseNeeds() shortage writes c.morale -=10; moraleMult=0.3+(morale/100)*0.9 scales output in phaseProduction()
evidence.G3: phaseHazard() sets building.damaged; damagedMult=0.5 in phaseProduction(); repairBuilding() spends parts and restores output
evidence.G4: buyPrice()/sellPrice() read resources/storageCaps ratio and globalDemand, which random-walks in phaseTrade()
evidence.G5: refugeesArrive: addColonists() vs scrip+morale; equipMalfunction: pay parts vs damageRandomBuilding() — both durable

ai_detail.single_biggest_weakness: Narrow-screen support (F12) is minimal — only a font-size media query — and population growth toward the win condition depends on a single event (refugeesArrive), the thinnest points in an otherwise fully-wired, deeply interconnected implementation.
